name: shopcart
description: ShopCart — a full-stack MERN e-commerce platform with cart, checkout, orders and an admin dashboard.
author: Mohammed Fayaz <kmdfayaz25@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.demo:seed: npm run seed -w server && DEMO_PASSWORDS='{"admin@shopcart.dev":"Admin@123","demo@shopcart.dev":"Demo@1234"}' npm run demo:export -w server
scripts.build:pages: VITE_DEMO=true VITE_BASE=/shopcart/ npm run build -w client && cp client/dist/index.html client/dist/404.html && touch client/dist/.nojekyll
